name: The First-Light Memory
introDiscord:
The Nexus becomes quiet.

Ahead is the Astral Sea before any of the places you know had their
names.

No ruins.

No kingdom.

No graveyard.

No trails.

Just first light over endless water.
introTwitch:
The Nexus becomes quiet.

Ahead is the Astral Sea before any of the places you know had their
names.

No ruins.

No kingdom.

No graveyard.

No trails.

Just first light over endless water.

the-first-light-memory-approach.prompt: Three impossible routes open across The First-Light Memory.

left.message: A First-Light Remnant forms from ancient Fae radiance.

right.message:
One Berry rests beside Shizuki's note:

'I don't know how Berry got here before berry plant.

I refuse to investigate.

Some mysteries are gifts.'

forward.message: Star Candies shine inside light older than modern constellations.

the-first-light-memory-depths.prompt: Deeper within The First-Light Memory, three paths bend through the unstable Nexus.

left.message: The first dawn warms the water and restores you.
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

right.message: A First-Light Remnant moves through the newborn sea.

forward.message: A tiny cache appears where no traveler should have existed.

the-first-light-memory-threshold.prompt: Near Origin Reflection, three final routes cross the edge of reality.

left.message: Light gathers into the shape of a familiar Star Candy.

right.message: The ancient sunrise restores you again.
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

bossPromptDiscord:
Origin Reflection brightens.

For a moment, there is no Moonlit Reef.

No Starfall Trench.

No Whispering Kelp Forest.

No Leviathan's Wake.

No Sunken King's Throne.

No Nexus.

Only the sea before the journey.

Use /yes to enter the first dawn or /no to leave it
untouched.

bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Origin Reflection. The impossible guardian will wait.

boss.revealText:
The horizon itself rises into living light.

Dawn Before the Sea reveals itself!

completionText:
The dawn settles.

Shizuki left no joke at the end.

Only:

'It was here before all of us.

It'll probably still be here after us.

That's kinda nice.'
